 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_STA_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:STA_CD);

 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
ELSE
RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 
END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$CHK_CODE_FNS_CDFN_DCLTN_S
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$CHK_CODE_FNS_CDFN_DCLTN_S */
PROCEDURE CGFK$CHK_CODE_FNS_CDFN_DCLTN_S(
 P_DCLTN_STA_DESC IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :CALLING_PARAMETERS.DCLTN_STA_DESC. */
 ,P_STA_CD IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :CALLING_PARAMETERS.STA_CD. */
 ,P_DCLTN_TYPE IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :CALLING_PARAMETERS.DCLTN_TYPE. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_DESC
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS DCLTN_ST
 WHERE DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = P_DCLTN_TYPE
 AND DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD = P_STA_CD
 AND DCLTN_ST.REC_STATUS = 1
 AND
 DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_TYPE;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_DCLTN_STA_DESC;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;
